comparison.objective: Hold a hand coffee grinder steady and turn its crank three full clockwise revolutions.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization plus sustained rotary crank manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Grinder is stabilized while the crank completes three clockwise turns.
comparison.reason: This shares generic bimanual stabilization and rotation, but it tests repetitive crank cycling rather than recessed setscrew unlocking, fine collar tuning from observed impacts, relocking, and retained non-bottoming performance. No spec versions are available.
